title: Rock, paper, scissors
hints: First fix the type: a union of string literals is written `"a" | "b" | "c"`. Then handle the draw case.
After the draw check, player 1 wins in exactly three situations (rock–scissors, scissors–paper, paper–rock). Combine them with `||`; in every other case player 2 wins.
if (a === b) return "draw"; if ((a === "rock" && b === "scissors") || (a === "scissors" && b === "paper") || (a === "paper" && b === "rock")) return "player1"; return "player2";
